## Specification

### Component: Progress

A bar (`Progress`) or ring (`ProgressCircle`) for a known amount of work. Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
- Linear: `<div class="ui-progress [ui-progress-<size>] [ui-progress-<tone>]" role="progressbar" data-state style="--ui-progress-pct:N"><span class="ui-progress-indicator"/></div>`.
- Circular: `<div class="ui-progress-circle [ui-progress-circle-<size>] …" role="progressbar">` with `<svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" aria-hidden>` holding track and indicator `circle`s (cx/cy 18, r 16, `pathLength="100"`) and `<span class="ui-progress-circle-value">`.

#### Props
- `value` number | null (null or omitted = indeterminate), `max` (100), `tone` `default|success|warning|destructive|info`, `getValueText(value, max)`.
- `Progress.size`: `sm` 4px · `md` 8px · `lg` 12px. `ProgressCircle.size`: `sm` 40 · `md` 64 · `lg` 96 · `xl` 128px; `children` replaces the centred percentage (`null` = none).

#### Behaviour
- Value is clamped to 0…max; `--ui-progress-pct` = percentage. `data-state`: `indeterminate` | `loading` | `complete`.
- ARIA: `role="progressbar"`, `aria-valuemin=0`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` (omitted when indeterminate), `aria-valuetext` (default "NN%"). The consumer supplies `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

#### Visual rules
- Track: tone 16% mix, pill, `overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate`. Indicator full width, `translateX(calc(pct × 1% − 100%))`, tone fill (default `--ui-primary`; tones use `--ui-success|warning|destructive|info`).
- Transition: `transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth)` (ring: `stroke-dashoffset`, same spring). No overshoot.
- Indeterminate bar: width 40%, `ui-progress-slide` (translateX −100% to 250%) 1.4s infinite. Ring: 28% arc spinning 1.1s.
- Ring: stroke width 3.2 (sm 4, lg 2.6, xl 2.2) in a 36 viewBox, round caps, rotated −90°, hidden when empty. Centre text size `max(11px, diameter × .24)`, tabular.

#### Motion
- Reduced motion: the indeterminate bar becomes a faint full-width bar; the ring stops spinning.

#### Acceptance checks
- `aria-valuenow` follows `value`; the indicator moves with the value; indeterminate has no `aria-valuenow`; heights 4/8/12.

### `ui/components/progress/progress.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type ProgressSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
export type ProgressTone = 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'destructive' | 'info';

interface ProgressBase extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'> {
  /** Current value. `null` or omitted means indeterminate (unknown duration). */
  value?: number | null;
  /** Value that means 100%. Default 100. */
  max?: number;
  /** Colour. Status tones only when the colour carries meaning (low disk space, failed upload). */
  tone?: ProgressTone;
  /** Human-readable value for screen readers, e.g. "3 of 5 files uploaded". Default: the percentage. */
  getValueText?: (value: number, max: number) => string;
}

function resolve(value: number | null | undefined, max: number) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(value)) return { pct: 0, state: 'indeterminate' as const, value: null };
  const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(value, 0), max);
  return { pct: max > 0 ? (clamped / max) * 100 : 0, state: clamped >= max ? ('complete' as const) : ('loading' as const), value: clamped };
}

function aria(value: number | null, max: number, getValueText: ProgressBase['getValueText'], pct: number) {
  return {
    role: 'progressbar' as const,
    'aria-valuemin': 0,
    'aria-valuemax': max,
    'aria-valuenow': value ?? undefined,
    'aria-valuetext': value === null ? undefined : (getValueText?.(value, max) ?? `${Math.round(pct)}%`),
  };
}

export interface ProgressProps extends ProgressBase {
  /** Track thickness: 4 / 8 / 12px. Default `md`. */
  size?: ProgressSize;
}

/**
 * Progress — a horizontal bar for a known amount of work. Needs an accessible
 * name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`). Changes of `value` glide on the
 * smooth spring. Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Progress = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ProgressProps>(function Progress(
  { value, max = 100, size = 'md', tone = 'default', getValueText, className, style, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const p = resolve(value, max);
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      data-state={p.state}
      className={cn('ui-progress', size !== 'md' && `ui-progress-${size}`, tone !== 'default' && `ui-progress-${tone}`, className)}
      style={{ '--ui-progress-pct': p.pct, ...style } as CSSProperties}
      {...aria(p.value, max, getValueText, p.pct)}
      {...props}
    >
      <span className="ui-progress-indicator" />
    </div>
  );
});

export type ProgressCircleSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

export interface ProgressCircleProps extends ProgressBase {
  /** Diameter: 40 / 64 / 96 / 128px. Default `md`. */
  size?: ProgressCircleSize;
  /** Centre content. Default: the percentage. Pass `null` for an empty ring. */
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * ProgressCircle — the same, as a ring with a value in the middle.
 */
export const ProgressCircle = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ProgressCircleProps>(function ProgressCircle(
  { value, max = 100, size = 'md', tone = 'default', getValueText, className, style, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const p = resolve(value, max);
  const centre = children === undefined ? (p.value === null ? null : `${Math.round(p.pct)}%`) : children;
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      data-state={p.state}
      className={cn('ui-progress-circle', size !== 'md' && `ui-progress-circle-${size}`, tone !== 'default' && `ui-progress-${tone}`, className)}
      style={{ '--ui-progress-pct': p.pct, ...style } as CSSProperties}
      {...aria(p.value, max, getValueText, p.pct)}
      {...props}
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
        <circle className="ui-progress-circle-track" cx="18" cy="18" r="16" pathLength={100} />
        <circle className="ui-progress-circle-indicator" cx="18" cy="18" r="16" pathLength={100} data-empty={p.pct === 0 && p.value !== null ? '' : undefined} />
      </svg>
      {centre !== null && centre !== false && <span className="ui-progress-circle-value">{centre}</span>}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/progress.css`

```css
/* Progress ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Linear:   <div class="ui-progress" role="progressbar" style="--ui-progress-pct:60">
               <span class="ui-progress-indicator"></span></div>
             + size: -sm -lg (md default)   + tone: -success -warning -destructive -info
             [data-state="indeterminate|loading|complete"]
   Circular: <div class="ui-progress-circle" role="progressbar" style="--ui-progress-pct:60">
               <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36"><circle class="ui-progress-circle-track"/>
               <circle class="ui-progress-circle-indicator" pathLength="100"/></svg>
               <span class="ui-progress-circle-value">60%</span></div>
             + size: -sm -lg -xl (md default)
   Value changes glide on --ui-spring-smooth (never overshoots).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-progress,
  .ui-progress-circle { --ui-progress-tone: var(--ui-primary); --ui-progress-pct: 0; }
  .ui-progress-success { --ui-progress-tone: var(--ui-success); }
  .ui-progress-warning { --ui-progress-tone: var(--ui-warning); }
  .ui-progress-destructive { --ui-progress-tone: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-progress-info { --ui-progress-tone: var(--ui-info); }

  /* Linear */
  .ui-progress {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-progress-tone) 16%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-progress-sm { height: 0.25rem; }
  .ui-progress-lg { height: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-progress-indicator {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background-color: var(--ui-progress-tone);
    transform: translateX(calc(var(--ui-progress-pct) * 1% - 100%));
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  [dir="rtl"] .ui-progress-indicator { transform: translateX(calc(100% - var(--ui-progress-pct) * 1%)); }

  .ui-progress[data-state="indeterminate"] .ui-progress-indicator {
    width: 40%;
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
    animation: ui-progress-slide 1.4s var(--ui-ease-in-out) infinite;
  }

  /* Circular */
  .ui-progress-circle {
    --ui-circle-size: 4rem;
    --ui-circle-stroke: 3.2;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-grid;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    place-items: center;
    width: var(--ui-circle-size);
    height: var(--ui-circle-size);
  }
  .ui-progress-circle-sm { --ui-circle-size: 2.5rem; --ui-circle-stroke: 4; }
  .ui-progress-circle-lg { --ui-circle-size: 6rem; --ui-circle-stroke: 2.6; }
  .ui-progress-circle-xl { --ui-circle-size: 8rem; --ui-circle-stroke: 2.2; }
  .ui-progress-circle > svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
    transform: rotate(-90deg);
  }
  .ui-progress-circle circle { fill: none; stroke-width: var(--ui-circle-stroke); }
  .ui-progress-circle-track { stroke: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-progress-tone) 16%, transparent); }
  .ui-progress-circle-indicator {
    stroke: var(--ui-progress-tone);
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-dasharray: 100;
    stroke-dashoffset: calc(100 - var(--ui-progress-pct));
    transition:
      stroke-dashoffset var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  /* A zero-length round cap would still paint a dot */
  .ui-progress-circle-indicator[data-empty] { opacity: 0; }
  .ui-progress-circle-value {
    position: relative;
    font-size: max(0.6875rem, calc(var(--ui-circle-size) * 0.24));
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ui-progress-circle[data-state="indeterminate"] > svg { animation: ui-spin 1.1s linear infinite; }
  .ui-progress-circle[data-state="indeterminate"] .ui-progress-circle-indicator { stroke-dashoffset: 72; transition: none; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    /* No sliding bar: a faint full-width bar says "busy" without implying a value */
    .ui-progress[data-state="indeterminate"] .ui-progress-indicator { width: 100%; animation: none; opacity: 0.35; }
    .ui-progress-circle[data-state="indeterminate"] > svg { animation: none; }
  }
}

@keyframes ui-progress-slide {
  from { transform: translateX(-100%); }
  to { transform: translateX(250%); }
}
```

## Usage

**Linear progress** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/progress/linear.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@/ui/components/progress';

const ROWS = [
  { id: 'storage', label: 'Storage', value: 62, text: '6.2 of 10 GB', tone: 'default' },
  { id: 'seats', label: 'Seats', value: 11, max: 12, text: '11 of 12 used', tone: 'warning' },
  { id: 'upload', label: 'Upload complete', value: 100, text: '100%', tone: 'success' },
] as const;

export default function ProgressLinear() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-5">
      {ROWS.map((r) => (
        <div key={r.id} className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between text-sm">
            <span id={`progress-${r.id}`} className="font-medium">
              {r.label}
            </span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{r.text}</span>
          </div>
          <Progress aria-labelledby={`progress-${r.id}`} value={r.value} max={'max' in r ? r.max : 100} tone={r.tone} />
        </div>
      ))}
      <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
        <Progress aria-label="Small" size="sm" value={40} />
        <Progress aria-label="Medium" value={40} />
        <Progress aria-label="Large" size="lg" value={40} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
